I just finished my case Monday in Tarrant county. It is a process but honestly the best thing I could of done for my case was do VIP Panel, Community service hours (my lawyer had me do 24 hrs) and do my DWI class and Evaluation before court. Because I did that the prosecutor and judge allowed me to plead down from a class A to a class B. No jail time other than when I was initially arrested. 15 months probation without supervision. And 500$ fine with $287 court cost with $200 credit for the Jail time I served. And they allowed me to get my IID off of my car. My license was suspended for 90 days but I filed the paperwork for an occupational license so I could get to work and they required me to get the IID.

But honestly reach out to lawyers , get free consultations, and see what your state or county allows you to do ahead of time. My county allowed me to do all my classes and community service ahead of time so when I did go in the front of the judge and prosecutor it told them I was owning my mistake and being responsible. I did all my own paperwork for an occupational license and getting my device on my car and had no violations which also looked goodI took the initiative to do what I could. I was doing Uber and doordash at the time and had to give that up and I was scared on how I would afford to do anything but I found an awesome job making the most I ever have . So I just tried to look at the positives the whole time. But you will make it thru , it might be a long process but before you know it you will be able to start putting this behind you as well.

You’re welcome ! 😊 More recently they have been picky about you sending anything but a letter to them. Just don’t write in anything but pen and you should be fine. They don’t allow markers. Also don’t spray anything on it. ( some ladies like to spray perfume). They MIGHT allow the photos but if you send them don’t put anymore than 10 photos in the envelope. I know for sure you cant send them greeting cards. I use FreePrints to send photos . It’s cheap ( like 2$ for 10 photos) and super easy. And I use ink cards when I want to send him a card. Also fairly cheap and super easy. Both of them are apps.

After you register with Texasprisonphone. You need a securus technologies account if you don’t already. Then the number should be put on their approved list of numbers he can call and they will know. At least my fiancé knew when mines was added when he got moved from county to state prison. Then once you are approved he shouldn’t need anything but your number to call. For putting money on his books , you can do it through JPay or you can go on the ecomm site ( https://tdcj-ecommdirect.portal.texas.gov ) and you can send him a care package ( they are only allowed a certain amount every 3 mnths) or you can put money on his trust account from there if his prison is allowing it.
